info.title: AriesHub API
info.description: Public content catalog, Redis-backed cookie identity, flat paged discussions with comment likes, administrator content and moderation API. Credit balance lives on users and pricing on publications; the credit ledger and unlock tables exist but the credit application API is not implemented yet. Private S3-compatible file uploads and owner-only temporary downloads. All JSON responses use Result {code,msg,data,traceId}; success code is SUCCESS, failures retain semantic HTTP status and business codes. Empty successes use HTTP 200 with data:null; throttling includes Retry-After and data.retryAfterSeconds. Admin operations dashboard, members, moderation and ledger. Private publication media, covers, featured flags and paid-body protection. Published card aggregation, current-account bookmarks and article likes, versioned free-body reading history and member home. Community activity and member widgets on the homepage are labelled UI previews; no activity feed API yet.
